name: Random Issue Gear
description: What a squad actually receives when requisition goes astray: roll 1d100 with the bonus or penalty set by the Logistics result. Characters are not officially responsible for anything received this way; the Departmento Munitorum is unaware the gear was issued. Only War, Table 6-5 (p. 167).

results.name: Below 0
results.text: A duffel filled with uniforms in desperate need of laundering.
A case of finely tailored dress uniforms, sized for Ogryns.
A 200 litre drum filled with concentrated acid.
A case of 20 suits of survival clothing appropriate to a climate that is not present within their field of operations.
A case of 20 magazines of ammunition for a special weapon that neither the squad nor their regiment normally fields.
A case of 12 spare components used for routine servitor maintenance.
A case of 10 standard entrenching tools.
A case of 100 copies of The Imperial Infantryman’s Uplifting Primer.
A case of 10 lasguns identical with those in the Standard Regimental Kit.
A 200 litre fuel drum filled with promethium.
A case of 40 power packs sized to fit the lasguns in the Standard Regimental Kit.
A case of 50 Ration Packs.
A case of 100 servings of Recaf.
A case of 4 grav chutes.
A case of 20 grenades (Game Master’s choice for type).
A file folder marked “High Command Only” containing extensive high-resolution orbital images of the battle front.
Inside of an unmarked wooden crate resides an ornately jeweled box that bears the seal of the Inquisition. (Contents of the box subject to the Game Master’s discretion.)
A case containing a single Heavy Weapon (Game Master’s choice) and 6 standard magazines/missiles/shells of ammunition for it.
A case containing 2 suits of Storm Trooper Carapace Armour.
A case of 24 Demolition Charges.
A case of 24 servings of High Provender.
A case of 48 doses of Stimm.
A case of 144 packs of 20 lho-sticks.
A case of 12 bottles of amasec.
Any 1 item of the player’s choice of up to Very Rare Availability.
Any 1 item of the player’s choice of up to Extremely Rare Availability.
